Summary: Medicine Database & Dataset
Description: Acquire, clean, and load a comprehensive Indian medicine dataset into the medicines table. Build search APIs and maintain data quality.

Summary: Admin Panel - Core Infrastructure
Description: Build the foundational admin panel: role enforcement, dashboard, audit logging, and admin layout components.

Summary: Admin Panel - Medicine Management
Description: Admin CRUD interface for managing the medicine database: add, edit, delete, bulk import/export.

Summary: Admin Panel - User Management
Description: Admin interface for managing users: list, activate/deactivate, role changes, bulk export.

Summary: Admin Panel - Doctor Verification
Description: Doctor verification workflow: review queue, approve/reject, document upload, suspension.

Summary: Prescription Enhancement
Description: Enhance prescription creation with medicine autocomplete, interaction warnings, PDF generation, and templates.

Summary: Patient Portal Enhancement
Description: Improve patient experience: profile editing, document upload, vitals tracking, health history.

Summary: Doctor Portal Enhancement
Description: Improve doctor experience: patient search, appointment management, analytics, clinical templates.

Summary: ABDM Integration
Description: Integrate with Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission: ABHA ID, HIP/HIU modules, consent management.

Summary: AI & Intelligence Features
Description: AI-powered features: record summarization, OCR, semantic search, lab report interpretation.

Summary: Multi-language & Localization
Description: Implement multi-language support: i18n framework, Hindi translations, prescription translation.

Summary: Notifications & Communication
Description: Email, SMS, WhatsApp, push, and in-app notification systems.

Summary: Security & Compliance
Description: Harden security: encryption, rate limiting, 2FA, data retention, compliance dashboard.

Summary: Testing & Quality
Description: Comprehensive testing: unit, integration, E2E, load testing, CI/CD pipeline.

Summary: Infrastructure & DevOps
Description: Production infrastructure: staging environment, monitoring, backups, object storage, caching.

Summary: Analytics & Reporting
Description: Admin analytics, doctor performance reports, patient health reports, usage metrics.

Summary: Research and acquire comprehensive Indian medicine dataset (50,000+ medicines with brand names, salts, manufacturers, dosage forms, strengths, MRP)
Description: Find and acquire a reliable Indian medicine dataset. Sources to explore: CDSCO drug database, 1mg/PharmEasy public data, Indian Pharmacopoeia. Target: 50,000+ medicines with fields: brand_name, salt_composition, manufacturer, dosage_form, strength, mrp, therapeutic_class, schedule.

Summary: Source drug interaction data from pharmacological database (DrugBank, OpenFDA, or CDSCO)
Description: Identify and acquire drug-drug interaction data. Map interactions to medicine pairs in our database. Store in medicines.interactions JSONB field.

Summary: Source alternative/generic medicine mappings for each branded drug
Description: Build a mapping of branded medicines to their generic equivalents and alternative brands with the same salt composition. Store in medicines.alternatives JSONB field.

Summary: Create data ingestion pipeline to parse, clean, and load raw medicine dataset into medicines table
Description: Build a Python script (backend/scripts/import_medicines.py) that reads CSV/JSON medicine data, validates fields, deduplicates, and bulk-inserts into the medicines table using SQLAlchemy.

Summary: Add therapeutic class categorization to every medicine entry
Description: Categorize all medicines by therapeutic class (Analgesic, Antibiotic, Antidiabetic, Antihypertensive, etc.). Add validation for allowed categories.

Summary: Add controlled substance schedule classification per Indian drug regulations (Schedule H, H1, X)
Description: Classify medicines by their drug schedule as per Indian Drugs and Cosmetics Act. Populate the medicines.schedule field.

Summary: Populate dosage_form field with standardized values (Tablet, Capsule, Syrup, Injection, etc.)
Description: Standardize dosage_form values across all medicines. Create an enum of allowed values: Tablet, Capsule, Syrup, Injection, Cream, Ointment, Drops, Inhaler, Powder, Gel, Suppository, Patch, Solution.

Summary: Create medicine search API endpoint (GET /api/v1/medicines/search) with full-text search
Description: Build API endpoint that searches medicines by brand_name and salt_composition. Support query parameter 'q', pagination with cursor, filter by therapeutic_class and dosage_form. Use PostgreSQL full-text search (tsvector/tsquery).

Summary: Add pgvector embeddings for semantic medicine search
Description: Generate vector embeddings for medicine descriptions using an embedding model. Enable semantic search (e.g., searching 'painkiller' returns Paracetamol, Ibuprofen). Leverage existing pgvector extension.

Summary: Build medicine autocomplete API endpoint for prescription forms
Description: Create GET /api/v1/medicines/autocomplete?q=para&limit=10 endpoint. Return top matches with id, brand_name, salt_composition, strength, dosage_form. Optimize for <100ms response time with proper indexing.

Summary: Create scheduled job to update medicine dataset periodically (new drugs, NPPA price updates)
Description: Build a periodic update mechanism (cron job or Celery task) to fetch updated medicine data from NPPA/CDSCO and merge into existing database without duplicates.

Summary: Write Alembic migration to add search indexes on medicines table
Description: Add indexes: GIN index on brand_name and salt_composition for full-text search, B-tree index on therapeutic_class, composite unique constraint on (brand_name, strength, manufacturer).

Summary: Add data validation rules to prevent duplicate medicines
Description: Add unique constraint on (brand_name, strength, manufacturer). Add validation in the ingestion pipeline to skip or merge duplicates.

Summary: Create medicine detail API endpoint (GET /api/v1/medicines/{id})
Description: Return full medicine details including alternatives array and interactions array. Include related medicines (same salt composition) in response.

Summary: Add medicine barcode/QR code lookup support
Description: Support scanning medicine packaging barcodes to look up medicine details. Requires barcode-to-medicine mapping data source.

Summary: Create admin role enforcement - require_admin() dependency with 403 responses
Description: Add require_admin() dependency in backend/app/dependencies.py. Check user.role == 'admin'. Return 403 Forbidden with proper error response if not admin.

Summary: Build admin API router (/api/v1/admin/) with admin-only middleware
Description: Create backend/app/routers/admin.py with APIRouter prefix='/api/v1/admin'. Apply require_admin dependency to all routes. Register in main.py.

Summary: Create admin dashboard page (/admin/dashboard) with summary statistics
Description: Build admin dashboard showing: total users (by role), total doctors (verified/unverified), total records (by type), total prescriptions, total medicines. Use cards with counts and trend indicators.

Summary: Add admin sidebar navigation component
Description: Create a collapsible sidebar with links: Dashboard, Users, Doctors, Medicines, Audit Log, Settings. Highlight active section. Responsive design.

Summary: Implement admin login flow with Keycloak admin role mapping
Description: Ensure Keycloak realm has 'admin' role. Map it in auto-provisioning logic. Admin users should be redirected to /admin/dashboard after login.

Summary: Build admin layout wrapper component with AuthGuard requiring admin role
Description: Create AdminLayout component wrapping all /admin/* pages. Include AuthGuard with requiredRole='admin', sidebar, and top bar with admin user info.

Summary: Create audit_logs table and Alembic migration
Description: Create migration for audit_logs table: id (UUID), admin_id (FK users), action (String), entity_type (String), entity_id (UUID), details (JSONB), ip_address (String), created_at (DateTime). Add index on (entity_type, entity_id) and (admin_id, created_at).

Summary: Create admin activity log model and service
Description: Build AuditLog SQLAlchemy model and audit_service.py with log_action() helper. Auto-log all admin write operations.

Summary: Build audit log API endpoints - list and filter
Description: GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs with filters: action_type, admin_id, entity_type, date_from, date_to. Paginated with cursor. Return audit log entries with admin user name.

Summary: Display recent activity feed on admin dashboard
Description: Show last 50 admin actions on dashboard as a timeline. Each entry shows: admin name, action description, timestamp, entity link.

Summary: Add admin route protection on frontend
Description: Add route guard logic in frontend to redirect non-admin users away from /admin/* paths. Show 'Access Denied' page if role doesn't match.

Summary: Build admin settings page for system-wide configuration
Description: Admin settings page for: default pagination limit, record retention days, maintenance mode toggle, allowed file upload types/sizes. Store in a settings table or config.

Summary: Build admin medicine list page (/admin/medicines) with table, search, and filters
Description: Paginated data table with columns: brand_name, salt_composition, manufacturer, therapeutic_class, dosage_form, strength, mrp, schedule. Search bar, filter dropdowns. Click row to edit.

Summary: Create admin add medicine form (/admin/medicines/new)
Description: Form with all medicine fields: brand_name, salt_composition, manufacturer, dosage_form, strength, therapeutic_class, schedule, mrp. Validation with Zod. Submit to POST /api/v1/admin/medicines.

Summary: Build admin edit medicine page (/admin/medicines/{id}/edit)
Description: Pre-populated edit form. Fetch medicine by ID, allow editing all fields. Submit to PUT /api/v1/admin/medicines/{id}. Show last updated timestamp.

Summary: Add bulk import UI - upload CSV to add/update medicines in batch
Description: CSV file upload component. Parse CSV client-side, show preview table with validation errors highlighted. Submit valid rows to bulk import endpoint. Show progress bar and results summary.

Summary: Add bulk export - download full medicine database as CSV
Description: Button to export all medicines as CSV. Include all fields. Support filtered export (only current search/filter results).

Summary: Create admin API endpoint to create a medicine (POST /api/v1/admin/medicines)
Description: Admin-only endpoint. Validate all fields with Pydantic schema. Check for duplicates before insert. Log action to audit log. Return created medicine.

Summary: Create admin API endpoint to update a medicine (PUT /api/v1/admin/medicines/{id})
Description: Admin-only endpoint. Partial update support. Validate fields. Log changes to audit log with before/after values. Return updated medicine.

Summary: Create admin API endpoint to soft-delete a medicine (DELETE /api/v1/admin/medicines/{id})
Description: Admin-only endpoint. Set deleted_at timestamp. Do not actually delete. Log to audit. Ensure soft-deleted medicines don't appear in search/autocomplete results.

Summary: Build medicine approval workflow - pending status for new medicines
Description: Add 'status' field to medicines (active, pending, rejected). Medicines added by doctors enter 'pending'. Admin reviews and approves. Only 'active' medicines appear in search.

Summary: Add drug interaction editor for admin
Description: Interface for admin to add/edit/remove drug interaction warnings. Select two medicines, define interaction severity (mild, moderate, severe) and description. Store in medicines.interactions JSONB.

Summary: Build admin user list page (/admin/users) with search and role filter
Description: Paginated table: full_name, email, phone, role, is_active, created_at. Search by name/email/phone. Filter by role (all/patient/doctor/admin) and status (active/inactive).

Summary: Create admin user detail page (/admin/users/{id})
Description: Show full user profile, linked doctor profile if applicable, count of records and prescriptions, account creation date, last login. Action buttons: activate/deactivate, change role, reset password.

Summary: Add admin ability to activate/deactivate user accounts
Description: Toggle is_active flag via PUT /api/v1/admin/users/{id}. Deactivated users should be blocked at the auth dependency level. Log action to audit.

Summary: Add admin ability to change user roles
Description: Allow changing role between patient/doctor/admin. If changing to doctor, auto-create doctor profile. If changing from doctor, handle gracefully. Sync with Keycloak roles via Admin API.

Summary: Build user creation form for admin
Description: Form to create users directly: full_name, email, phone, role, password. Create in both Keycloak and local DB. Send welcome email with credentials.

Summary: Create admin API endpoints for user CRUD (GET/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/admin/users/{id})
Description: GET: return user with doctor profile if exists. PUT: update fields (full_name, email, phone, role, is_active, language_pref). DELETE: soft delete. All admin-only with audit logging.

Summary: Build admin bulk user export as CSV
Description: Export user list matching current filters as CSV. Include: full_name, email, phone, role, is_active, created_at. Exclude sensitive data.

Summary: Add user activity timeline on admin user detail page
Description: Show chronological list of user actions: account created, records created, prescriptions received, profile updates, login events. Requires activity tracking.

Summary: Implement admin password reset via Keycloak Admin API
Description: Call Keycloak Admin REST API to trigger password reset email for a user. Requires backend service account with Keycloak admin privileges.

Summary: Add user account merge functionality for duplicate patients
Description: Select two patient accounts to merge. Transfer all records and prescriptions to the surviving account. Soft-delete the duplicate. Requires careful data migration logic.

Summary: Build doctor verification queue page (/admin/doctors/pending)
Description: List all doctors where verified=false. Show: name, email, specialization, license_number, facility, registration date. Actions: View Details, Approve, Reject.

Summary: Create doctor verification detail page with document review
Description: Show full doctor profile, uploaded documents (license, ID proof), and verification checklist. Admin can add notes, approve or reject with reason.

Summary: Add API endpoint to approve/reject doctor verification
Description: PUT /api/v1/admin/doctors/{id}/verify with body: {action: 'approve'|'reject', reason: string}. Update verified flag. Log to audit. Trigger notification to doctor.

Summary: Send notification to doctor on verification approval/rejection
Description: Email notification to doctor with verification result. Include reason if rejected. Include next steps (e.g., resubmit documents).

Summary: Add doctor document upload support (license certificate, ID proof)
Description: Add document upload to doctor registration/profile flow. Store in S3/MinIO. Link documents to doctor profile. Support PDF, JPG, PNG up to 5MB.

Summary: Build verified doctor badge display on patient-facing views
Description: Show a verified checkmark badge next to doctor names on patient timeline and record detail views. Only for doctors where verified=true.

Summary: Add doctor suspension capability for admin
Description: Admin can suspend a doctor's access temporarily. Add 'suspended' status. Suspended doctors can't create records or prescriptions. Show suspension reason.

Summary: Create admin doctor list page (/admin/doctors) with verification filters
Description: Paginated table of all doctors. Columns: name, specialization, facility, license_number, verified status, created_at. Filter by: verified/unverified/suspended.

Summary: Integrate medicine autocomplete into prescription creation form
Description: Replace free-text medicine name input with autocomplete component that queries GET /api/v1/medicines/autocomplete. Show brand_name, salt_composition, strength in dropdown. Set medicine_id on selection.

Summary: Auto-populate dosage form, strength, and MRP when medicine selected
Description: When doctor selects a medicine from autocomplete, auto-fill the dosage_form, strength, and MRP fields. Allow doctor to override if needed.

Summary: Show real-time drug interaction warnings on prescription form
Description: When multiple medicines are added, check for interactions between all pairs. Show warning banner with severity (mild/moderate/severe) and interaction description. Allow doctor to proceed with acknowledgment.

Summary: Display alternative/generic medicine suggestions
Description: When a branded medicine is selected, show a collapsible section with generic alternatives and other brands with the same salt. Show price comparison (MRP).

Summary: Add prescription PDF generation with doctor details and QR code
Description: Generate a PDF prescription with: clinic header, doctor details, patient info, date, Rx symbol, medicine table (name, dosage, frequency, duration, timing), diagnosis, notes, doctor signature placeholder, QR code linking to digital prescription.

Summary: Build prescription print view with standard Indian Rx format
Description: Create a print-optimized page (/patient/prescriptions/{id}/print) with standard Indian prescription layout. Use @media print CSS. Include Rx header, patient demographics, medicine table.

Summary: Add prescription sharing via link or SMS/WhatsApp
Description: Generate a shareable link (with expiry token) for a prescription. Option to send via SMS or WhatsApp. Link opens a read-only prescription view (no auth required, time-limited).

Summary: Implement prescription refill request workflow
Description: Patient can request a refill on an existing prescription. Doctor receives notification and can approve (creates new prescription) or deny with reason. Track refill history.

Summary: Add prescription validity tracking with patient notifications
Description: Check prescription valid_until dates. Notify patients 7 days before expiry and on expiry day. Show expiry status badge on prescription list.

Summary: Create prescription history comparison view
Description: Side-by-side view of two prescriptions for the same patient. Highlight added, removed, and changed medicines. Useful for tracking treatment changes over time.

Summary: Add dosage calculator for pediatric dosing based on weight/age
Description: Calculator tool on prescription form. Input: patient weight (kg) or age. Calculates recommended dose for selected medicine. Based on standard pediatric dosing guidelines.

Summary: Build prescription templates - save and reuse common prescription combos
Description: Doctors can save a prescription as a template (name + medicine list). Recall templates when creating new prescriptions. Templates stored per doctor. CRUD API for templates.

Summary: Build patient profile edit page - update phone, language, emergency contact
Description: Editable profile form. Fields: full_name (read-only from Keycloak), phone, language_pref (dropdown), emergency_contact_name, emergency_contact_phone. Save to PUT /api/v1/patients/profile.

Summary: Add patient medical history summary - allergies, conditions, blood group
Description: New section on patient profile: blood_group, allergies (list), chronic_conditions (list), height, weight. New DB columns or JSONB field. Editable by patient.

Summary: Create patient appointment booking system
Description: Appointment booking flow: search doctors by specialization/city, view available slots, book slot, receive confirmation. Requires appointments table, doctor schedule, and booking API.

Summary: Build patient notification center
Description: Notification bell icon in navbar with unread count. Dropdown showing recent notifications. Full notifications page with mark-as-read, filter by type. Requires notifications table.

Summary: Add patient document upload for lab reports and external records
Description: Upload UI on patient timeline. Accept PDF, JPG, PNG (max 10MB). Store in S3/MinIO. Create medical_record entry with source='uploaded'. Show upload progress bar.

Summary: Implement patient health vitals tracking - BP, blood sugar, weight, temperature
Description: New vitals logging page. Quick-entry form for common vitals. Store in vitals table (patient_id, vital_type, value, unit, recorded_at). Show recent readings on dashboard.

Summary: Build vitals chart/graph view - visualize health trends
Description: Line charts showing vital trends over time (last 30/90/180 days). Use a charting library (recharts or chart.js). Separate charts per vital type. Show normal ranges as shaded bands.

Summary: Add patient family member linking - view dependents' records
Description: Link family members (children, elderly parents) to a patient account. View their records. Requires family_links table and consent workflow. Role: 'caregiver'.

Summary: Create patient medication reminder feature
Description: Based on active prescriptions, generate reminder schedule. Push notifications for medicine intake times. Snooze/dismiss functionality. Track adherence percentage.

Summary: Build patient feedback/rating system for doctor visits
Description: After a record is created, patient can rate the visit (1-5 stars) and leave feedback. Stored in visit_feedback table. Visible to doctor on their analytics.

Summary: Add patient record download - export health history as PDF
Description: Button on timeline to export all records (or filtered set) as a single PDF document. Include: patient info header, chronological records with summaries, prescription details.

Summary: Create patient emergency card view - scannable critical info
Description: A mobile-friendly card showing: name, blood group, allergies, emergency contact, chronic conditions, current medications. QR code linking to digital profile (with consent-gated access).

Summary: Build doctor appointment management page
Description: View upcoming and past appointments. Confirm, reschedule, or cancel appointments. Calendar view (day/week). Integrate with appointment booking system.

Summary: Add patient search by name/phone/email on doctor dashboard
Description: Replace UUID-only patient lookup with searchable input. Search across patient name, email, and phone. Return matching patients with basic info. Much better UX than entering raw UUIDs.

Summary: Create doctor schedule management - set available time slots
Description: Weekly schedule editor. Set available hours per day. Define slot duration (15/20/30 min). Mark holidays/leave. Store in doctor_schedules table.

Summary: Build doctor analytics dashboard - patients seen, common diagnoses
Description: Charts showing: patients seen per week/month, records created per type, most common diagnoses, prescription count trend. Summary cards with key metrics.

Summary: Add clinical notes template system for common conditions
Description: Pre-built templates for common conditions (Fever, URI, Diabetes follow-up, Hypertension). Template includes: typical notes, common prescriptions, follow-up instructions. Doctor can customize before saving.

Summary: Implement doctor-to-doctor referral workflow
Description: Doctor can refer a patient to another doctor with referral notes. Receiving doctor gets notification. Referral tracked in referrals table. Patient can see referral in timeline.

Summary: Build doctor patient history quick-view before creating new record
Description: On record creation page, show patient's last 5 records inline (collapsible). Includes: record type, title, date, brief description. Helps doctor see context before writing new notes.

Summary: Add voice-to-text for clinical notes using browser Speech Recognition API
Description: Microphone button on clinical notes textarea. Uses Web Speech API for real-time transcription. Doctor reviews and edits transcribed text before saving. Works in Chrome/Edge.

Summary: Create doctor notification system - appointments, patient messages, verification
Description: Notification bell for doctors. Alerts for: new appointment bookings, patient messages, verification status update, referral responses.

Summary: Build doctor public profile page - view credentials and facility info
Description: Public-facing page /doctors/{id} showing: name, specialization, facility, city, verified badge, experience. Accessible to patients for choosing a doctor.

Summary: Integrate ABHA ID creation - allow patients to link or create ABHA ID
Description: Integration with ABDM APIs to create ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) ID. Flow: verify Aadhaar/mobile OTP, create ABHA, link to patient profile. Store abha_id in users table.

Summary: Implement ABDM Health Information Provider (HIP) module
Description: Build HIP module to share patient records via ABDM consent framework. Implement: /on-discover, /on-link, /on-consent, /health-information/request endpoints per ABDM specs.

Summary: Implement ABDM Health Information User (HIU) module
Description: Build HIU module to fetch patient records from other ABDM-linked facilities. Implement: /consent-requests/init, /health-information/fetch endpoints. Display external records in patient timeline.

Summary: Build patient consent management UI for ABDM data sharing
Description: Consent management page for patients. View pending consent requests, approve/deny, set time-limited access, revoke previously granted consents. Follows ABDM consent artifact spec.

Summary: Add ABDM facility registry integration
Description: Register MedConnect facility in ABDM Health Facility Registry (HFR). Store facility registration ID. Required for HIP/HIU operations.

Summary: Implement ABDM health locker integration
Description: Integrate with ABDM health locker for long-term patient record storage. Patients can push records to their locker. Retrieve records from locker.

Summary: Add Aadhaar/mobile OTP-based ABHA verification flow
Description: OTP verification flow: enter Aadhaar/mobile, receive OTP, verify, link ABHA. Use ABDM auth APIs. Handle error cases (invalid Aadhaar, expired OTP).

Summary: Create ABDM compliance audit logging
Description: Log all ABDM data exchanges: consent requests, data shares, data fetches. Required for ABDM compliance audits. Separate abdm_audit_logs table.

Summary: Build ABDM data push - auto-push records on patient consent
Description: When a new record is created and patient has active consent, automatically push record to ABDM. Background job with retry logic.

Summary: Add ABDM sandbox testing environment configuration
Description: Configure environment variables for ABDM sandbox. Document sandbox credentials and testing flow. Ensure all ABDM APIs hit sandbox in development.

Summary: Implement AI-powered medical record summarization (auto-generate ai_summary)
Description: Use LLM (GPT-4/Claude API) to generate concise summaries of medical records. Populate ai_summary field. Trigger on record creation. Show summary on patient timeline.

Summary: Add OCR for uploaded documents - extract text from scanned prescriptions/lab reports
Description: Integrate OCR (Tesseract.js or Google Cloud Vision) to extract text from uploaded images/PDFs. Store extracted text in raw_text field. Use for search indexing.

Summary: Build AI symptom checker for patients
Description: Conversational symptom checker. Patient describes symptoms, AI asks follow-up questions, suggests possible conditions and urgency level. Clear disclaimer: not a diagnosis. Recommends seeing a doctor.

Summary: Implement AI-powered medicine interaction checker using NLP
Description: Use NLP to analyze medical literature for drug interactions beyond our structured database. Provide evidence-based interaction warnings with source citations.

Summary: Add smart search across records using pgvector semantic search
Description: Generate embeddings for all medical records. Enable semantic search: 'heart problems' finds cardiology records, ECG reports, etc. Augment existing full-text search.

Summary: Create AI lab report interpreter - explain lab values in simple language
Description: For lab report records, use AI to explain each lab value: what it measures, whether the value is normal/high/low, what it might indicate. Display in patient-friendly language.

Summary: Build AI health risk assessment - flag high-risk patients
Description: Analyze patient's complete record history to identify risk factors. Flag patients with patterns suggesting high risk for conditions (diabetes, heart disease). Alert doctors.

Summary: Implement AI prescription validation - check for dosage errors and contraindications
Description: Before prescription is saved, AI validates: dosage within recommended range, no contraindications with patient's known conditions, no dangerous interactions. Show warnings to doctor.

Summary: Add multilingual AI translation for prescriptions and records
Description: Use LLM to translate prescription instructions and record summaries into patient's preferred language (Hindi, Tamil, Bengali, etc.). Store in prescription.translated JSONB.

Summary: Build AI clinical decision support - suggest diagnosis codes and treatments
Description: Based on doctor's clinical notes, suggest ICD-10 codes and evidence-based treatment protocols. Reference clinical guidelines. Doctor approves/modifies suggestions.

Summary: Implement i18n framework in Next.js frontend (next-intl or next-i18next)
Description: Set up i18n with next-intl. Create locale files structure (en.json, hi.json). Wrap all user-facing strings with translation function. Configure locale detection.

Summary: Create Hindi language translation file for all UI strings
Description: Translate all English UI strings to Hindi. Cover: navigation, buttons, form labels, error messages, status badges, empty states. Professional translation (not Google Translate).

Summary: Add language selector in navbar with preference persistence
Description: Language dropdown in navbar. Options: English, Hindi (add more later). On change: update UI language, save preference to user profile via API, persist across sessions.

Summary: Implement prescription translation - display instructions in patient's language
Description: Translate medicine instructions (dosage, frequency, timing) into patient's preferred language. E.g., 'Take 1 tablet twice daily after food' → Hindi equivalent. Use structured translations.

Summary: Add RTL support for Urdu language
Description: Add RTL (right-to-left) CSS support. Use dir='rtl' attribute. Ensure all layouts, forms, and text render correctly in RTL mode. Test with Urdu translations.

Summary: Create translation management admin page
Description: Admin page showing all translation keys. Side-by-side English + target language. Admin can edit translations inline. Export/import translation files.

Summary: Set up email service integration (SendGrid or AWS SES)
Description: Configure email provider. Create email sending service in backend. Support HTML templates. Handle bounces and delivery status. Environment-based configuration.

Summary: Build email notification templates - welcome, prescription ready, appointment reminder
Description: Design and build HTML email templates: welcome email (on signup), prescription ready (when doctor creates prescription), appointment reminder (24h before), password reset. Responsive design.

Summary: Implement SMS notifications via Indian gateway (MSG91 or Twilio)
Description: Integrate SMS gateway for India. Send: OTP codes, appointment reminders, prescription ready alerts. Respect DND preferences. Template-based SMS with sender ID.

Summary: Add WhatsApp Business API integration
Description: Integrate WhatsApp Business API for: prescription sharing (PDF), appointment reminders, two-way messaging. Use approved message templates. Handle opt-in/opt-out.

Summary: Build in-app notification system with unread count badge
Description: Notifications table (user_id, type, title, message, read, created_at). Bell icon in navbar with unread count. Dropdown showing recent notifications. Mark as read on click. Full notifications page.

Summary: Create notification preferences page
Description: Settings page where users choose: which notifications to receive (appointments, prescriptions, reminders) and via which channel (in-app, email, SMS, WhatsApp). Store in user_notification_prefs table.

Summary: Implement push notifications for web (Service Workers / Web Push API)
Description: Set up VAPID keys. Register service worker. Prompt user for push permission. Send push notifications for time-sensitive alerts (appointment in 1 hour, prescription ready).

Summary: Add real-time notifications using WebSocket or Server-Sent Events
Description: Implement WebSocket endpoint (or SSE) for real-time notification delivery. Frontend connects on login. New notifications appear instantly without page refresh.

Summary: Implement field-level encryption for sensitive medical data (PHI) at rest
Description: Encrypt sensitive fields (diagnosis, clinical notes, medicine details) before storing in DB. Use AES-256 with key management. Decrypt on read. Transparent to application logic.

Summary: Add rate limiting on all API endpoints
Description: Implement rate limiting using Redis. Limits: 100 req/min per user for reads, 20 req/min for writes, 5 req/min for auth endpoints. Return 429 with Retry-After header.

Summary: Implement RBAC audit - verify all endpoints have proper role checks
Description: Audit every API endpoint. Verify: auth dependency applied, correct role check (patient/doctor/admin), no endpoint accessible without authentication. Document findings and fix gaps.

Summary: Add CSRF protection for state-changing operations
Description: Implement CSRF token validation for all POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints. Generate token on session init. Validate on every state-changing request. SameSite cookie configuration.

Summary: Build data retention policy enforcement
Description: Configurable retention period (e.g., 7 years for medical records per Indian regulations). Auto-archive records past retention. Admin can configure per record type. Never auto-delete, only archive.

Summary: Implement IP-based access logging and suspicious activity detection
Description: Log IP address, user agent, and geolocation for every authenticated request. Detect anomalies: multiple failed logins, unusual location, rapid requests. Alert admin on suspicious patterns.

Summary: Add two-factor authentication support via Keycloak (TOTP/SMS)
Description: Enable TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password) in Keycloak. Add 2FA setup flow in user profile. Require 2FA for admin and doctor roles. Support authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy).

Summary: Create security compliance dashboard for admin
Description: Dashboard showing compliance status: DISHA compliance checklist, encryption status, 2FA adoption rate, access audit findings, data retention status. Exportable compliance report.

Summary: Write unit tests for all backend services - target 80% coverage
Description: Write pytest unit tests for record_service.py and prescription_service.py. Mock database sessions. Test: create, retrieve, list, pagination, filtering, error cases. Use pytest-cov for coverage reporting.

Summary: Write API integration tests for all endpoints using pytest + httpx
Description: Integration tests hitting actual API endpoints with test database. Test: auth flow, patient endpoints, doctor endpoints. Verify response schemas, status codes, pagination, error responses.

Summary: Set up frontend unit tests with Jest + React Testing Library
Description: Configure Jest and RTL in Next.js frontend. Write tests for: AuthGuard component, Navbar, timeline page, record detail page, prescription form. Mock API calls with MSW.

Summary: Create end-to-end tests with Playwright for critical flows
Description: E2E tests covering: login flow, patient views timeline, patient views record detail, doctor creates record, doctor creates prescription. Run against full Docker Compose stack.

Summary: Add load testing scripts using Locust or k6 - simulate 1000 concurrent users
